notes.title: H9 – English & Simplified Chinese Available at Launch
notes.content:
Greetings, investigators!
 We’re thrilled to confirm that our fake-documentary horror adventure game “H9” will ship with full language support in:
[olist]
[*]Japanese
[*]English
[*]Simplified Chinese
[/olist]
We’ll continue to evaluate additional languages based on community feedback. Stay tuned for future updates, and thank you for your ongoing support!
